# Smogon damage calculator attribution

This project uses the browser distribution of **@smogon/calc 0.12.0**, the official damage-calculation library from [smogon/damage-calc](https://github.com/smogon/damage-calc).

- License: MIT
- Source: https://github.com/smogon/damage-calc
- Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@smogon/calc
- Browser bundles are pinned to version 0.12.0 and loaded from UNPKG.
- The Champions damage formula is selected by Smogon's generation-0 data/mechanics implementation.

The full MIT license text is in LICENSE.txt. The project-specific adapter in optimizador-smogon.js is original integration code; it is not a copy of Smogon's implementation.
